# Tailored Tools

> Websites and business systems for owner-run businesses, based in Maidstone, Kent. Every build starts with a live prototype the client sees before paying anything. Tailored Tools is the trading name of James Edwards (sole trader, established April 2026).

## What we do

Tailored Tools builds websites and systems for owner-run businesses: salons, therapists, teachers, studios, agencies. Clients usually arrive asking for something small (a price list, a booking button, somewhere to put a timetable); the job is finding the bigger problem underneath and building the fix. After launch, a monthly care plan covers hosting, security, backups and same-day changes sent by WhatsApp.

## Prices (published, "from" prices; quotes add only what the business needs, line by line)

- Foundation: from £750 setup, then £45/month (£40/month on an optional client-chosen 2-year term). Bespoke website, copy, forms, mailing list, care plan.
- Studio: from £1,950 setup, then £75/month. Everything in Foundation plus online booking and payment, service menus and price builders, automated forms and reminders, self-edit tools.
- Platform: from £4,500 setup, then from £150/month. Apps, client portals, back-office systems, automation, AI features where they save real time.
- No contract on the care plan; clients own their domain and accounts from day one. Third-party costs are paid by the client at cost and listed in writing before committing.
- https://tailored-tools.com/pricing

## How we work (the method)

Every website build is prototype-first: the client answers a twelve-question brief, and within days sees a live website at a real URL (their name, story and branding, with working forms) before paying anything. Prototypes ship with a built-in feedback button that pipes client notes straight to Tailored Tools; feedback is usually live the same day. Clients register their own domains in their own accounts via plain-English walkthroughs (they own everything: domain, accounts, payments; nothing is locked to Tailored Tools). Before committing, every client gets a written list of every running cost, including traps to avoid (first-year teaser pricing, renewal jumps, unnecessary add-ons).
- https://tailored-tools.com/how-i-work
- Start a brief: https://tailored-tools.com/brief/

## Client work

### Mane London (hair and beauty salon, Bexley)
Asked for 100 printed price lists. Got a new website, live the next day (1 Oct 2026): a price menu that changes with the chosen stylist level, build-a-visit sent to the salon by WhatsApp, a "This month" offers board updated the same day, and print and web menus generated from one price file. Booking stays on Vagaro.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/mane-london
- Live site: https://manelondon.co.uk

### Connected Pathways (systemic therapy and education consultancy, Kent)
Asked for a professional website. Got a website plus a practice set up on Cliniko: three booking pathways with payment taken at booking, intake forms and secure video links sent automatically, branded confirmation and reminder emails, and the practitioner's address hidden everywhere. Launched 7 Sep 2026; online booking with payment live 29 Sep 2026.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/connected-pathways
- Live site: https://velmabennett.co.uk

### Good Knight Yoga (yoga, breathwork and meditation, Kent)
Brief sent on a Sunday evening; a live site to react to within a day. A brand drawn from the teacher's name (night sky, named constellations), classes for two teachers with one mailing list, and an admin page so she updates retreats herself. Launched 7 Aug 2026.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/good-knight-yoga
- Live site: https://goodknightyoga.co.uk

### Ace & Jacks Poker League (weekly pub poker, Watford, Hemel and Dunstable) - in build
Sixteen seasons ran on a football-league WordPress plugin. New phone-first public site built in a day; a back office designed around the administrator's three jobs (enter results, manage players, start a season in one step) is being built. Season 16 already migrated and checked with zero problems (41 nights, 197 players, 1,116 results). Live for Season 17 on 30 November 2026.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/ace-jacks

## Closer to home

### Performance Interpreting
A family-run BSL interpretation agency in the UK and Ireland (run by Marie Pascall). Built the PI Events App (launched May 2026). Month 1 traction: 800+ downloads, 110+ venues onboarded with access and contact data, around £5,000 of bookings generated through app-originated interpreter requests, and the first confirmed bookings already delivered. The wider PI OS booking platform is in progress beneath it.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/performance-interpreting

PIPA (Performance Interpreting Personal Assistant): an AI assistant on performanceinterpreting.co.uk that searches interpreted events, looks up venue access, plays PI's own signed videos and builds interpreter-request links, handing over to a person when it can't help. In PI's setlist tool it answers interpreters' questions and writes "Song insights" (themes, register, figurative language, ambiguous lines) from stored lyrics, clearly labelled as AI-generated. PIPA helps people; it never replaces interpreters.

### PI Events App (consumer-side case study)
Native iOS and Android app for the UK Deaf community: every PI-delivered BSL/ISL event in one place, AI-drafted access request emails for events without coverage, a Communication Tool Kit for the venue itself, sign-language video on every screen, offline-first, BSL-first onboarding. Peer-recommended at DeafExpo 2026, featured by The Limping Chicken.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/pi-events-app

### The Sonic Sanctuary
James's own sound therapy practice, running on a unified business platform that replaced 6 separate tools: event management, Stripe payments, intro pass system, WhatsApp integration, customer comms, B2B booking, and a public website fed from the same data source. Reaches an audience of 1,259 across WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram, and saves roughly 5 hours of admin a week.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/sonic-sanctuary

## Agent Optimisation (AO), also available

### AO Audit, £247
A scored audit across six dimensions: data readability, service descriptions, pricing signals, trust signals, availability, and AI visibility. PDF report with prioritised recommendations. Turnaround: 5 working days.

### AO Implementation, from £497
Making your business fully AI-readable so AI agents can confidently recommend you.

### AO Audit + Implementation Bundle, £697
Full audit followed by complete implementation. Save £47 vs booking separately.

### AO Monitoring, £97/month
Monthly AI credibility monitoring across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude. Accuracy checks, narrative protection, competitor tracking, regression alerts. Annual: £970/year.

### AO Workshops (available on request)
90-120 minute hands-on workshop with live audit demonstration for up to 30 people.

- https://tailored-tools.com/ao/

## Kent AI Community

Kent AI is a free, grassroots community in Kent for anyone curious or concerned about AI. Monthly in-person meet-ups at The Bull, Linton, Maidstone (next date being arranged; watch the Facebook group), plus an active Facebook group and WhatsApp threads. No jargon, no judgement.
- https://tailored-tools.com/community/

## About

Tailored Tools is the trading name of James Edwards (sole trader, established April 2026). Based in Maidstone, Kent, UK. James runs The Sonic Sanctuary (his own sound therapy practice) and builds and runs the tech behind Performance Interpreting (run by his spouse Marie Pascall). Not a tech person selling AI, a business owner who found it genuinely useful and now helps other small businesses do the same.
- https://tailored-tools.com/about
